authors: J. Fokken, C. Sieg, M. Wilhelm
title: The complete one-loop dilatation operator of planar real beta-deformed N=4 SYM theory
claim: Finite-size corrections missing from the asymptotic one-loop dilatation operator of the real beta-deformation are derived for U(N) and SU(N); for SU(N) the absent U(1) modes give a new finite-size effect ('prewrapping'); classes of correlators equal to their undeformed values at all planar orders are identified; one-loop spectrum of single-trace states with Delta_0 <= 4.5 and their multiplet structure.
loop_order: 1 (with all-order statements on classes of correlators)
theory: planar real beta-deformed N=4 SYM, U(N) and SU(N)
scheme: Feynman diagrams (dimensional regularization assumed; details not verified)
symmetry_argument: N=1 SUSY of the beta-deformation plus inheritance arguments from N=4 for planar correlators; U(1) decoupling analysed explicitly.

proved: prewrapping effect for SU(N) at one loop; U(N) vs SU(N) difference in the 't Hooft limit for short states (per abstract)

evidence: Abstract (paraphrased): complete one-loop dilatation operator, prewrapping for SU(N), Delta_0 <= 4.5 spectrum
red_flags: earlier beta-deformed computations that use SU(N) and the asymptotic operator (e.g. S1a.04) must be checked for prewrapping for short states; the statement is that the gauge group choice matters even at large N
notes: Included because it is a DR-based demonstration that symmetry/finite-size structure assumed by integrability must be supplemented for SU(N) deformed theories.
